subject: MAP: POC environment preflight & ownership matrix
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: POC environment preflight & ownership matrix

Hi Alyssa —

Great to meet earlier. Per our discovery, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan focused on the POC environment preflight. I pulled together the milestone list, target dates, and the owners we discussed. Please review and confirm or suggest edits.

High-level POC milestones (draft):
- Network & connectivity: VPC peering established, routing verified — owner: NovaCorp network team (target: 2026-11-01)
- IP allowlists: public egress / API IPs added to allowlist — owner: NovaCorp security (target: 2026-11-03)
- Secrets & KMS: key access pattern and KMS roles defined (bring-your-own-KMS or Redwood-managed?) — owner: joint (target: 2026-11-05)
- SSO/SAML: SAML metadata exchange + test user login — owner: NovaCorp IAM, Redwood to provide SP metadata (target: 2026-11-08)
- Validation & smoke tests: end-to-end POC run and signoff — owner: joint (target: 2026-11-12)

Target close / POC signoff date: 2026-11-19
Dependencies & asks from your side (what we need to make progress):
- VPC peering request (CIDR blocks + preferred peering window) and any firewall rules that require exception.
- IP allowlist entries (we will provide a short list of egress IPs and FQDNs).
- SAML metadata or a contact for your IdP (IdP SAML metadata, test user).
- KMS access model: are you using a customer-managed KMS (Azure Key Vault/AWS KMS) or do you want Redwood-managed secrets? If customer-managed, we need IAM role ARNs and an owner for rotation policy.

Attachments: redwood_map_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), novacorp-network-diagram.png (placeholder).

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm owners in-line with the milestones above (reply with names + email).
2) Provide a point of contact for networking and security so we can loop them into the peering/work sessions.
3) We will schedule a 30-min technical preflight with our infra engineer to walk the peering and IPs (available next Tue/Wed).

If this looks good I’ll convert the sheet to a living MAP in HubSpot and update timelines as owners confirm.

Thanks —
Rishi
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood-inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0189

Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@novacorp.com>, networkops@novacorp.com
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment preflight & ownership matrix

Thanks Rishi — this is very helpful. I reviewed the draft with the network team this morning. Quick notes:

- We will own the VPC peering request and routing changes. Point of contact: Tom Ellis (cc’d).
- For IP allowlists, we need the list of outbound IPs you expect the POC to use. We will add those to the firewall and the app allowlist.
- We use an internal KMS (AWS KMS). We’ll need the exact IAM ARNs and the required key policy changes before we hand over access.
- SSO: our IdP team needs your SP metadata and a test user. I can have IdP metadata over by EOD Mon.

Can you confirm who from Redwood will be the technical lead for the peering session? Also, please share the egress IPs and the minimum ports/protocols required.

A couple of scheduling constraints: we have a change freeze the week of 2026-11-08, so earlier peering is better.

Best,
Alyssa Chen
Product Operations Manager | NovaCorp
alyssa.chen@novacorp.com

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding NovaCorp confirmation. Tom will drive peering on their side and Alyssa will share IdP metadata by EOD Mon. They’ve flagged a change freeze the week of 11/08, so we should prioritize the peering and IP allowlist before then.

Can you each own the following?
- Marissa: lead the peering session, prepare the peering runbook and the list of IPs we will present to NovaCorp (include any egress ranges and published FQDNs). Please coordinate a 45-min window next Tue/Wed for the technical preflight.
- Karthik: prepare a concise SAML/SP integration pack (metadata, ACS URL, example assertion attributes, and a short test plan). If they’re using AWS KMS, include the IAM ARNs we’ll need and a proposed key policy template.

If you can reply with owner-confirmation and estimated completion dates by EOD Monday I’ll lock the MAP timelines and share the HubSpot map with NovaCorp.

Thanks —
Rishi
